summary: Count items and repeated statements in the cost check, and add an advisory N+1 report script

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild. Test-only counting and an offline report script; the daemon is unchanged.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change.

recovery.detail: Nothing to recover: the statement histogram exists only in test and test-support builds, and the report script is advisory and never fails a build.
